mechanism_narrative: The steady four-week rise in RESIDENTIAL mobility (11.6 to 17.7) reflects deepening stay-at-home behavior that substitutes for discretionary retail trips, so RETAIL_REC will continue to average lower over the next four weeks than the last four.
evidence_refs: fact:RESIDENTIAL rose every week from t-3w to t-0w
failure_condition: RETAIL_REC 28-day forward mean is equal or higher than its 28-day trailing mean despite RESIDENTIAL continuing an upward trend, rejecting the substitution mechanism.

mechanism_narrative: A rapid multi-week collapse in TRANSIT mobility signals escalating movement restrictions; once TRANSIT falls more than 20 points over three consecutive weeks, retail access is further curtailed, driving RETAIL_REC lower over the subsequent two weeks.
candidate_trigger: TRANSIT falls more than 20 points cumulatively over 3 consecutive weeks
evidence_refs: fact:TRANSIT dropped from -50.4 at t-3w to -66.0 at t-0w, a 15.6 point fall accelerating week over week
failure_condition: RETAIL_REC stabilizes or rises over the next 2 weeks even though the TRANSIT threshold condition was met at the decision point.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous sharp declines in WORKPLACES and TRANSIT compound to suppress incidental shopping trips normally bundled with commuting, producing a larger joint negative effect on RETAIL_REC than either series alone would predict over the next four weeks.
evidence_refs: fact:both WORKPLACES and TRANSIT fell every week from t-3w to t-0w
failure_condition: RETAIL_REC decline over the next 4 weeks is no larger than what WORKPLACES alone would predict, indicating no amplifying interaction with TRANSIT.

mechanism_narrative: In a tightening-restrictions regime during the cooler season, the sharp drop in PARKS mobility (-25.1 to -37.9) removes outdoor substitution options that previously offset some retail suppression, so RETAIL_REC continues falling over the next two weeks.
evidence_refs: fact:PARKS fell sharply to -37.9 at t-0w while RETAIL_REC fell to -38.4 in the same week
failure_condition: RETAIL_REC rises over the next 2 weeks despite PARKS remaining depressed below -35, indicating no seasonal substitution linkage.

mechanism_narrative: The one-week shock drop in GROCERY_PHARM (-2.9 to -11.1) indicates a sudden restriction announcement causing a short-lived panic-buying/avoidance spike; once this transient effect fades within a week, RETAIL_REC rebounds modestly.
candidate_trigger: GROCERY_PHARM drops more than 8 points in a single week
evidence_refs: fact:GROCERY_PHARM fell 8.2 points from t-1w (-2.9) to t-0w (-11.1)
failure_condition: RETAIL_REC continues to decline in the week immediately following the GROCERY_PHARM shock, showing no rebound.

mechanism_narrative: The accelerating week-over-week decline in RETAIL_REC itself (-22.0, -22.1, -24.4, -38.4) reflects strengthening negative momentum that will persist via habituation and reduced store operating hours, keeping RETAIL_REC lower over the next four weeks.
evidence_refs: fact:RETAIL_REC weekly change magnitude grew from -0.1 to -2.3 to -14.0 across the last three transitions
failure_condition: RETAIL_REC's week-over-week decline reverses to a positive change within the next 2 weeks, breaking the momentum assumption.

mechanism_narrative: Rising RESIDENTIAL time combined with falling WORKPLACES attendance jointly signal a structural shift toward home-based routines, where the interaction of these two trends reduces combined errand and retail trips more than either trend alone over the next four weeks.
evidence_refs: fact:RESIDENTIAL rose from 11.6 to 17.7 while WORKPLACES fell from -22.0 to -31.4 over the same four weeks
failure_condition: RETAIL_REC forward mean rises even as both RESIDENTIAL keeps increasing and WORKPLACES keeps decreasing, indicating no compounding interaction effect.

mechanism_narrative: Once TRANSIT mobility crosses below -60%, this marks entry into a severe lockdown regime (e.g., Stage 4-equivalent restrictions) in which non-essential retail is formally closed, causing an immediate further step-down in RETAIL_REC within one week.
evidence_refs: fact:TRANSIT reached -66.0 at t-0w, crossing below -60 for the first time in the snapshot
failure_condition: RETAIL_REC does not fall further in the week after TRANSIT first crosses below -60, or stabilizes near its current level.
